bugs.description: Policy was accepted in-conversation (policy_accepted=true, policy_version_accepted=1.0 passed to book tool), but final state shows customer_consents_count=0 and policy_accepted_at=null. The consent audit row and customers.policy_accepted_at were not written to the DB.

check_availability confirmed July 4 at 09:00 with Marta as available across multiple turns (source: checkpoint), but the live book call in turn 8 rejected it as unavailable ('El hueco ya no está disponible'). The check_availability tool appears to return stale or cached availability and does not perform a definitive lock check. The book tool is the true gatekeeper.
bugs.evidence: check_availability status=ok for 2026-07-04T09:00:00+02:00; book status=rejected same slot

bugs.description: Scenario expected afternoon (tarde) slots to be available for acceptance. The bot correctly reported no tarde availability for tomorrow (July 1) and the 7-day window returned only morning slots (9:00-11:20 range). The booking ultimately completed with a morning slot (10:00 July 7). This may reflect real calendar state rather than a bot logic error.
